name: DeadShare
storyline:
Capital City, 2010, nine years before the outbreak that will later consume it. Somewhere beneath the city, in rooms that officially do not exist, a game show called SIXFOLD goes on air. Its first known set is a flooded chamber deep in the Lower Sewers.

Six strangers are strapped into electric chairs around a single table, each with a console in front of them and a mascot of their own on the screens above. The host, a cheerful cartoon duck named Quackers, explains the only rules that matter: every round each contestant secretly chooses whether to attack another seat, counter the one they fear, or hold. The show reveals who dies, never who did it.

Those who survive split the prize pool. Those who don’t leave their winnings behind for the others. Nobody knows who runs SIXFOLD, who watches it, or why the broadcast keeps finding new rooms.
summary: Six seats. Six players. One game show that smiles while it watches you. Make your secret pick, read the room, and stay in your seat while the wheel turns on SIXFOLD, the 2010 TV show nobody was meant to see.
